result.topic_en: Draft notes for Riemann's paper on the propagation of plane air waves of finite amplitude: thermodynamic relations between pressure, density and temperature (specific heats K and V), and calculations with derivatives of functions f and ψ(σ).
result.transcription:
Über die Fortpflanzung von Luftschwingungen (Luftwellen[?]) [?]
von B. Riemann.

Obgleich die Differentialgleichungen, nach welchen sich die Bewegung der Luft [?] bestimmt, längst aufgestellt worden sind, so ist doch ihre Integration fast nur für den Fall ausgeführt worden, wenn die Druckverschiedenheiten als unendlich klein

$K d\sigma + V d\tau$ [-$p = k\varrho t$-]
[-$p = \varrho t$-]
$p = \varrho\tau$ $\log p = \log\varrho + \log\tau + \text{const.}$
[-$K d\sigma$-] $\frac{\partial\log\tau}{\partial\log\varrho} =$
$K dp + V d\varrho$
[-$K\frac{\partial\tau}{\partial p}$-] $K\frac{\partial\tau}{\partial\varrho}d\varrho + V\frac{\partial\tau}{\partial p}dp$ $K\tau$
$= \tau(K\,\partial\log\varrho + V\,\partial\log p)$
$\frac{K}{V} = k$ $K - V$ $1{,}421$ $1{,}410$
$\tau(V\,\partial\log p - K\,\partial\log\varrho)$
$\tau\,K\,\partial\log\varrho - V\,\partial\log p$ $1{,}410$ $1{,}421$
[-$A$-]$\tau(K - V)\,\partial\log v = $[-$A$-]$p\,dv$
$K - V = \frac{pv}{A\tau}$ $423{,}55$

$f((p-p')(q-q')\psi(\sigma))$
$\frac{\partial f}{\partial p} = f'\cdot(q-q')\psi(\sigma) + (p-p')(q-q')$[-...-]
$\frac{\partial^2 f}{\partial p\,\partial q} = f''((p-p')\psi\sigma + (p-p')(q-q')\psi'\sigma)((q-q')\psi(\sigma))$
$+(p-p')(q-q')\psi''\sigma$
$+ f'$[-$(\psi(\sigma) + (p-p')(q-q')\psi'\sigma + (p-p')(q-q')\psi''\sigma)$-]
[-$(p-p')(q-q')\psi(\sigma)$-]
$f'(q-q')\psi(\sigma)\left(1 + (p-p')\frac{\partial\log\psi(\sigma)}{\partial\sigma}\right)$
$f''(p-p')(q-q')\psi\sigma^2\left(1 + (p-p')\frac{\partial\log\psi\sigma}{\partial\sigma}\right)\left(1 + (q-q')\frac{\partial\log\psi\sigma}{\partial\sigma}\right)$
$f'(\psi\sigma + (\sigma-\sigma')\psi'(\sigma) + (p-p')(q-q')\psi''(\sigma))$
$+ f''((p-p')(q-q')(\psi(\sigma))^2 + (\sigma-\sigma')\psi(\sigma)\psi'(\sigma) +$
$(p-p')(q-q')\psi'(\sigma)^2)$
$\frac{\psi'(\sigma)^2}{\psi(\sigma)}$ $\psi(\sigma)(\psi(\sigma) + (\sigma-\sigma')\psi'(\sigma)) = \psi''(\sigma)\alpha$
$\frac{\psi'(\sigma)^2}{\psi(\sigma)} = \beta\psi''(\sigma) = $[-$k^2\psi(\sigma)$-]
$\psi(\sigma)(1 + k(\sigma-\sigma')) = k^2\alpha$ $\psi'(\sigma) = k\psi(\sigma)$
$\frac{1}{\psi(\sigma)} =$
$\beta\frac{\partial\log\psi'(\sigma)}{\partial\sigma} = \beta\frac{\partial\log\psi(\sigma)}{\partial\sigma}$ $k\psi(\sigma) = $[-$k$-]$\psi'(\sigma)$

$\log p + \log v = \log T + \text{const.}$
$K\frac{\partial T}{\partial\varrho}d\varrho + V\frac{\partial T}{\partial p}dp = T(K\,\partial\log v + V\,\partial\log p)$
$\psi(\sigma) = k(\sigma-\gamma)^{\beta}$ $\beta = -1$
$k(\sigma-\gamma)^{2\beta-1}((\sigma-\gamma) + \beta(\sigma-\sigma'))$
$= \alpha(\sigma-\gamma)^{\beta-2}k\beta(\beta-1)$
$\psi(\sigma) = \frac{k^2\alpha}{1 + k(\sigma-\sigma')}$
$\frac{\partial\log\psi(\sigma)}{\partial\sigma} = \frac{k}{1 + k(\sigma-\sigma')}$

methods.what: Ideal gas law and its logarithmic form
Heat supplied expressed in logarithmic differentials of density and pressure
Mayer relation: difference of specific heats from mechanical equivalent of heat
Mixed second derivative of composite function f((p-p')(q-q')ψ(σ))
ODE condition on ψ and power-law trial solution

items.english: Although the differential equations which determine the motion of air were set up long ago, their integration has been carried out almost only for the case when the pressure differences [are treated] as infinitely small
